occurrences.title: Mathematical Methods for the Physical Sciences I: Placement Exam
occurrences.content:
Mathematical Methods for the Physical Sciences I: Placement Exam

- Response time is factored into the scoring, but don't rush! What's most important 
            is that you answer correctly any questions that you understand.

- You can take a break in between questions. Each question is timed independently.

- Exiting a question before answering it will result in the question 
            being marked as incorrect.

- If you don't know how to answer a question, click the **Don't Know** button. 
            Guessing will only make the results less accurate.

- Expect to get wrong answers. This is not a performance assessment, but an adaptive 
            diagnostic that is attempting to find the contour of your knowledge profile.
